verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: The cable routing is documented across pages 13-16 with colour-coded overlays: (1) Page 13 (img-028): Aerial rooftop view shows the proposed PV array (blue rectangle), LA (yellow dot), and AC cable (orange), AC earthing (green), LA cable (purple) routes running from the PV area toward the building edge — continuous run established. (2) Page 13 (img-030): Terrace room shows AC cable (green) and LA/DC earthing (purple) entering the Enphase accessories box on the wall — connects to prior segment. (3) Page 14 (img-031): Terrace-level external routing shows orange, green, and purple cable lines running horizontally past the AC outdoor unit — continuous with prior segment. (4) Page 14 (img-033): Cable runs shown descending vertically through the red metal staircase/duct area — continuation confirmed. (5) Page 14 (img-034): Electrical room — AC cable (orange) and AC earthing (green) enter through upper grill window and route to the meter bank; purple LA cable branches off; Main Meter (red) and Solar Meter (blue) annotated — run terminates correctly. (6) Page 15 (img-036): Basement area — AC Earth Pit, DC Earth Pit, and LA Pit marked with cable runs terminating at each pit location — earthing runs terminate correctly. (7) Page 15 (img-037): Close-up of Main Meter and Solar Meter with AC cable connection shown via purple annotation. The full chain — panels → Enphase microinverters → AC cable → Enphase accessories box (terrace room) → horizontal run along terrace → down through duct → electrical room → Solar Meter → Main Meter, with earthing branches to basement pits — is continuous and shown in sequential photos without orphan ends or unexplained deviations. Note: because this is a pre-installation TSVR, cables are shown as proposed overlay lines rather than installed conduit/clips, so physical installation continuity (conduit, clipping) cannot be confirmed pre-install.
verdicts.rationale: The cable routing documentation traces a complete, unbroken path from the proposed PV area to the meter room across 7 sequential photos (pages 13-16) with no orphan ends or mid-run discontinuities; confidence is medium because cables are proposed overlays not yet installed conduit, so physical clipping/conduit verification must await installation.
